## Aaron Maher - SEA Championship (AUS vs SGP) - Biomechanical Assessment

Aaron Maher demonstrated a consistently high degree of forward spine lean (39.5° average) which, *within the context of Freestyle Wrestling*, appears strategically employed as a defensive posture to deter deep penetration takedowns – effectively presenting a structural barrier. His elbow and knee flexion angles suggest a reactive, bent-knee stance prioritizing quick level changes for defense and counter-attacks, evidenced by the two level-change shots, but potentially limiting explosive offensive entries. The overwhelming time spent in ground/scramble situations (85.7%) indicates a need to improve initial hand-fighting to disrupt opponent entries *before* reaching clinch range, or to proactively establish dominant underhooks to dictate positional control.
